title: Refuse excluded untracked child attributes that can normalize tracked edits
outcome: Committed runtime exclusions cannot authorize an untracked or ignored child .gitattributes that hides tracked-byte changes.
acceptance: A real child checkout counterexample establishes conversion-hidden tracked edits through an excluded untracked or ignored .gitattributes, with unchanged pin and a clean-status precondition.

Production admission refuses the unsafe attribute source inside the initialized-child boundary while ordinary-root behavior, committed attribute policy, declaration grammar for unrelated runtime files and existing bounds remain unchanged.
Tests include a restored admitted neighbor and the correction receives the required review and validation.
